descriptionByLocale.en:
Summary

Shape the future of innovation by establishing project management excellence across our global R&D organization. As Project Management Officer & Business Analyst, you will drive governance, portfolio insights, and continuous improvement while enabling informed decision-making and successful project execution.

What You'll Do

• Design, govern and continuously improve multi‑project management frameworks, standards and governance for Group Division Innovation (R&D).

• Define, implement and operate project management processes, methods, tools, KPIs and evaluation criteria, acting as the go‑to expert for methodology.

• Perform portfolio, budget and performance controlling analyses; synthesize multi‑source data and recommend actions to support management decisions.

• Own the continuous improvement of methods, standards and tools, identifying root causes and ensuring sustainable adoption across teams. Act as a change agent by translating methodological and process-related improvements into compelling narratives for executives, steering committees and project teams, ensuring alignment, buy-in and sustainable implementation.

• Provide expert guidance, training and coaching to peers and stakeholders to ensure correct application of methods and compliance with standards.

• Facilitate cross‑functional alignment on resources, priorities and ways of working; resolve complex methodological and governance issues.

• Establish and maintain transparent documentation and reporting standards for steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Who You Are

•
 Degree in Business Informatics, Engineering, or relevant field (ETH/ University/ University of Applied Sciences)

• Strong expertise in classic and agile project management, with a clear focus on methodology, governance and process excellence.

• Proven experience influencing and enabling cross‑functional stakeholders in a matrix organization.

• Analytical, structured thinking with a problem‑solver mentality.

• Solid business acumen with the ability to translate data and insights into pragmatic recommendations. Strong stakeholder intuition and interpersonal skills; able to quickly read situations and audiences, adapt communication styles and build trust across all levels – from executive committees to project teams.

• Fluent business English (written and spoken); confident working in an international, multicultural environment.

• Project management certification (PfMP, IPMA B) preferred.

• Proactive, service‑oriented personality with high accountability and resilience.

Who We Are

At Belimo, we take pride in making our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and encourage new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees are not only creating amazing products, they are revolutionizing the HVAC industry. Investing in our people is at the heart of Belimo's approach to engaging diverse creative talent to grow an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the expertise and commitment of each individual.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per rafforzare il nostro workshop, stiamo cercando una personalità impegnativa e versatile con il know-how tecnico e un modo di lavoro orientato alla soluzione. In questo ruolo, contribuisci attivamente alla produzione di prototipi, all'espansione delle nostre attrezzature e allo sviluppo continuo del workshop.

Cosa farai

• Produzione di parti prototipi mediante disegno su macchine convenzionali e controllate da CNC (Mastercam)

• Progettazione e produzione autonoma di attrezzature quali sistemi di contatto, test e dispositivi e strumenti

• Manutenzione e manutenzione di strumenti a fornitori esterni

• Sostenere il direttore del workshop e vice in sua assenza

• Partecipazione attiva all'espansione e sviluppo del workshop

• Ottenere offerte e strumenti, materiali e assemblaggi complessi

Chi sei

• Formazione tecnica completata (ad esempio polimeccanica, meccanica, utensili) con ulteriore formazione nel settore tecnico (HF)

• La conoscenza della pneumatica ed elettrica/elettronica è vantaggiosa

•
Esperienza nell'assemblaggio e nella gestione di assiemi tecnici

•
Rapida comprensione e un metodo di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione

•
Gestione sicura delle applicazioni PC comuni e degli strumenti tecnici

• Team-oriented, affidabile e resiliente – anche in situazioni frenetiche

•
Forte capacità di comunicazione e apertura nel trattare con diversi contatti

•
Entusiasmo per la tecnologia e la motivazione per lo sviluppo continuo

Chi siamo

A Belimo, siamo orgogliosi di rendere la nostra azienda un luogo gratificante per lavorare. I nostri leader sono orientati al valore e promuovono nuove idee nelle loro squadre in tutto il mondo. Attraverso la nostra passione, i nostri dipendenti non solo creano prodotti sorprendenti, ma anche rivoluzionano l'industria HVAC. Investire nei nostri dipendenti è al centro di Belimo quando si tratta di coinvolgere diversi talenti creativi per costruire una società leader del settore. Il successo del nostro marchio aziendale si basa sulla competenza e l'impegno di ogni individuo.
descriptionByLocale.en:
To strengthen our workshop, we are looking for a committed and versatile personality with technical know-how and a solution-oriented way of working. In this role, you actively contribute to the production of prototypes, the expansion of our equipment and the continuous development of the workshop.

What will you do

• Production of prototype parts by drawing on conventional and CNC-controlled machines (Mastercam)

• Design and stand-alone production of equipment such as contact, test and device systems and tools

• Maintenance and maintenance of tools at external suppliers

• Supporting the workshop manager and deputy in his absence

• Active participation in the expansion and further development of the workshop

• Obtaining offers and procuring tools, materials and complex assemblies

Who you are

• Completed basic technical training (e.g. polymechanic, mechanic, toolmaker) with further training in the technical field (HF)

• Knowledge of pneumatics and electrical/electronics is advantageous

•
Experience in assembly and in dealing with technical assemblies

•
Rapid understanding and an independent, structured and solution-oriented working method

•
Safe handling of common PC applications and technical tools

• Team-oriented, reliable and resilient – even in hectic situations

•
Strong communication skills and openness in dealing with different contacts

•
Enthusiasm for technology and motivation for continuous development

Who we are

At Belimo, we are proud to make our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and promote new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees not only create amazing products, but also revolutionize the HVAC industry. Investing in our employees is at the heart of Belimo when it comes to engaging diverse creative talents to build an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the competence and commitment of each individual.

Zur Verstärkung unserer Werkstatt suchen wir eine engagierte und vielseitige Persönlichkeit mit technischem Know-how und einer lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise. In dieser Rolle trägst du aktiv zur Herstellung von Prototypen, zum Ausbau unserer Betriebsmittel sowie zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Werkstatt bei.

Was wirst du tun

• Herstellung von Prototypenteilen nach Zeichnung auf konventionellen sowie CNC-gesteuerten Maschinen (Mastercam)

• Konstruktion und eigenständige Fertigung von Betriebsmitteln wie Kontakt-, Prüf- und Vorrichtungssystemen sowie Werkzeugen

• Wartung und Instandhaltung von Werkzeugen bei externen Lieferanten

• Unterstützung des Werkstattleiters sowie Stellvertretung bei dessen Abwesenheit

• Aktive Mitwirkung beim Ausbau und der Weiterentwicklung der Werkstatt

• Einholung von Offerten sowie Beschaffung von Werkzeugen, Materialien und komplexen Baugruppen

Wer du bist

• Abgeschlossene technische Grundausbildung (z. B. Polymechaniker, Mechaniker, Werkzeugmacher) mit Weiterbildung im technischen Bereich (HF)

• Kenntnisse in Pneumatik sowie Elektrik/Elektronik von Vorteil

•
Erfahrung in der Montage sowie im Umgang mit technischen Baugruppen

•
Rasche Auffassungsgabe sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

•
Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen PC-Anwendungen und technischen Tools

• Teamorientiert, zuverlässig und belastbar – auch in hektischen Situationen

•
Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Offenheit im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern

•
Begeisterung für Technik sowie Motivation zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung

Wer wir sind

Bei Belimo sind wir stolz darauf, unser Unternehmen zu einem lohnenden Arbeitsplatz zu machen. Unsere Führungskräfte sind werteorientiert und fördern neue Ideen in ihren Teams auf der ganzen Welt. Durch unsere Leidenschaft schaffen unsere Mitarbeiter nicht nur erstaunliche Produkte, sondern revolutionieren auch die HLK-Branche. Die Investition in unsere Mitarbeitenden ist das Herzstück von Belimo, wenn es darum geht, verschiedene kreative Talente zu engagieren, um ein branchenführendes Unternehmen aufzubauen. Der Erfolg unserer Unternehmensmarke basiert auf der Kompetenz und dem Engagement jedes Einzelnen.

Correzione rapida e professionale dei guasti e dei tempi di fermo degli impianti durante il funzionamento a turni

Monitoraggio degli elementi vegetali e delle azioni proattive secondo gli accordi di livello di servizio

Creazione e ottimizzazione dei piani di manutenzione in collaborazione con la pianificazione della manutenzione

Metodo di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione con elevata responsabilità personale

Rapida comprensione, pensiero in rete e azione proattiva e innovativa

What will you do

•
Rapid and professional correction of faults and plant downtimes during shift operation

•
Monitoring plant elements and proactive action in accordance with service level agreements

•
Implementation and coordination of planned maintenance and maintenance work

•
Creation and optimization of maintenance plans in cooperation with maintenance planning

•
Ensuring quality standards and continuous improvement by identifying vulnerabilities

•
Ensuring the safety, availability and reliability of installations

•
Collaboration in commissionings, conversions, maintenance and cross-departmental projects

•
Support, training and professional guidance of employees

Who you are

Completed further training as a maintenance specialist (Federal Fa) or comparable qualification

•
Mind. 5 years of experience in the maintenance of production and logistics facilities

•
Experience in direct customer contact and strong service orientation

•
Very good German (minimum B2) and good English skills (minimum B1)

Independent, structured and solution-oriented working method with high personal responsibility

•
Rapid comprehension, networked thinking and proactive and innovative action

Team-capable, communicative and flexible personality with high commitment and physical resilience

Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt und ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung

Selbständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung

Costruzione, fabbricazione e costruzione di sistemi di postazione di lavoro (montaggi di montaggio, carri materiali, sistemi di taglio, illuminazione, ecc.) secondo i principi LEAN e 5S

stretta collaborazione con progettazione, laboratorio di prova, tecnologia di prova e partner interni ed esterni

Do you not only want to assemble, but also create jobs that make everyday production easier, more efficient and more ergonomic? To strengthen our team, we create an additional position and look forward to a personality who tackles, thinks and improves.

What will you do

•
Construction, manufacture and construction of workstation systems (assembly workstations, material wagons, shelving systems, lighting, etc.) according to LEAN and 5S principles

•
Close cooperation with design, test workshop, test technology and internal and external partners

•
Mechanical machining of various materials (cutting, drilling, mounting)

•
Coordination of orders, appointments and coordination with internal customers and suppliers

•
Preparation of operating instructions, safety documentation and calculation of weight loads

•
Analysis and optimization of workstations, material flows and storage processes in the sense of LEAN and 5S

•
Support for internal relocations as well as for the commissioning and dismantling of workstation systems

descriptionByLocale.en:
Summary

As a Senior Equipment Software Architect, you design the software architecture of complex plant and production systems and thus significantly shape their future viability. You develop robust, scalable solutions and combine business and engineering requirements for viable architectures.

What you will do

• Responsibility for the development and coordination of scalable, modular software architectures for plants and machines across different platforms and projects as well as derivation of technical solutions based on production processes and plant requirements.

• Central contact person for cross-divisional architecture topics at the interface of plant software, hardware control, automation systems and factory integration as well as ensuring compliance with architecture principles, software standards and strategic digitalization goals.

• Transfer of system and process requirements into architecture artifacts (e.g. control processes, interfaces, boundary conditions and quality features such as reliability, availability and maintainability) and governance of standardized interfaces between machine software, subsystems (e.g. PLC, motion control, image processing) and higher-level systems (MES, SCADA, cloud).

• Ensure seamless system integration and interoperability through close collaboration with cross-functional teams, and promote consistency and reusability across multiple asset platforms to reduce implementation effort and life-cycle costs.

• Professional leadership within the equipment software community through mentoring, design reviews and architecture workshops, as well as promoting knowledge exchange and technical excellence.

• Ensure robust handling of real-time requirements, functional safety and high operational stability in industrial environments.

• Documentation, communication and continuous development of architectural decisions, architectural patterns and development methods.

Who you are

• Completed degree in computer science, information technology or comparable engineering, if possible at level MSc

• Several years of experience in the system or platform architecture for embedded systems.

• In-depth knowledge in hardware and system integration as well as in cross-departmental architecture design.

• Experience with architectural methods, MBSE (Model-Based Systems Engineering) and Systems Engineering.

• Ability to make well-founded technical decisions, lead interdisciplinary teams and convincingly communicate and represent architectural decisions to stakeholders.

PLC, contrôle des mouvements, traitement des images) et les systèmes de niveau supérieur (MES, SCADA, cloud).

Bei uns erwartet dich ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet im Bereich Master Data Management , in dem du Verantwortung für Produktions- und Stammdaten übernimmst und aktiv an globalen Projekten mitarbeitest. Freue dich auf ein dynamisches Umfeld, in dem deine Arbeit direkten Einfluss auf unsere Prozesse und die Zusammenarbeit in der Supply Chain hat.

Was wirst du tun

• Anlegen, Pflegen und Verwalten von Materialstammdaten im SAP-System, einschließlich Artikeldaten, Stücklisten und Arbeitsplänen im Rahmen der Materialanlageprozesse

• Bearbeiten technischer Änderungen sowie globale Koordination von Änderungsfällen entlang der Supply Chain

• Durchführen von Kalkulationsläufen für die Einzelstückkosten in SAP

• Steuern und globales Koordinieren von Materiallöschungen, Bestandsbereinigungen und Liquidationen

• Überwachen des Produktlebenszyklus sowie Pflege und Steuerung des Status-Netzwerks auf Werksebene für alle Materialstämme in den Customizing-Centern der Region

• Mitarbeiten und teilweise Übernehmen der fachlichen Koordination in Supply-Chain-Themen innerhalb von Projekten sowie Unterstützen der globalen Teams

Wer du bist

• Du hast einen Bachelorabschluss, vorzugsweise mit Schwerpunkt auf Daten, Analytics (Data Science, Data Analytics o.ä.) oder Betriebswirtschaft

• Du verfügst über mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung in der Arbeits- bzw. Produktionsplanung sowie in der Stammdatenpflege

• Du hast Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und kannst eigenständig Projekte koordinieren

• Du kennst dich gut mit SAP aus, insbesondere in den Modulen MM und PP

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Du arbeitest strukturiert, analytisch und genau, bist effizient und zielorientiert

• Du bist eine angenehme, kommunikative und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit

Wer wir sind

Bei Belimo sind wir stolz darauf, unser Unternehmen zu einem lohnenden Arbeitsplatz zu machen. Unsere Führungskräfte sind werteorientiert und fördern neue Ideen in ihren Teams auf der ganzen Welt. Durch unsere Leidenschaft schaffen unsere Mitarbeiter nicht nur erstaunliche Produkte, sondern revolutionieren auch die HLK-Branche. Die Investition in unsere Mitarbeitenden ist das Herzstück von Belimo, wenn es darum geht, verschiedene kreative Talente zu engagieren, um ein branchenführendes Unternehmen aufzubauen. Der Erfolg unserer Unternehmensmarke basiert auf der Kompetenz und dem Engagement jedes Einzelnen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous recherchons une personnalité engagée pour notre équipe au siège de Hinwil. Avec nous, vous pouvez vous attendre à un domaine de responsabilité varié dans le domaine de Master Data Management, dans lequel vous assumez la responsabilité de la production et des données master et participez activement à des projets mondiaux. Nous nous réjouissons d'un environnement dynamique où votre travail a un impact direct sur nos processus et la coopération dans la chaîne d'approvisionnement.

Que ferez-vous ?

• Création, tenue à jour et gestion des données de base du matériel dans le système SAP, y compris les données d'éléments, les listes de pièces et les plans de travail dans les processus des usines de matériaux

• Traitement des changements techniques et coordination mondiale des cas de changement le long de la chaîne d'approvisionnement

• Effectuer des cycles de calcul pour les coûts unitaires individuels dans SAP

• Fiscalité et coordination mondiale des extinctions matérielles, des ajustements des stocks et des liquidations

• Surveiller le cycle de vie du produit ainsi que maintenir et contrôler le réseau d'état au niveau de l'usine pour toutes les souches de matériaux dans les centres de personnalisation de la région

• Collaborer et assumer partiellement la coordination technique dans les domaines de la chaîne d'approvisionnement au sein des projets et soutenir les équipes mondiales

Qui vous êtes

• Vous avez un baccalauréat, de préférence avec un accent sur les données, l'analyse (science des données, analyse des données, etc.) ou l'administration des affaires

• Vous avez plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans la planification du travail ou de la production ainsi que dans la maintenance des données master

• Vous avez de l'expérience en gestion de projet et pouvez coordonner les projets de manière indépendante

• Vous connaissez SAP, en particulier dans les modules MM et PP

• Vous avez de très bonnes compétences en anglais en paroles et en écriture

• Vous travaillez structuré, analytique et précis, efficace et orienté vers l'objectif

• Vous êtes une personnalité agréable, communicative et orientée vers l'équipe

Qui nous sommes

Chez Belimo, nous sommes fiers de faire de notre entreprise un lieu de travail enrichissant. Nos dirigeants sont motivés par la valeur et font la promotion de nouvelles idées dans leurs équipes à travers le monde. Grâce à notre passion, nos employés non seulement créent des produits étonnants, mais révolutionnent également l'industrie du CVC. Investir dans nos employés est au cœur de Belimo quand il s'agit de mobiliser divers talents créatifs pour construire une entreprise leader de l'industrie. Le succès de notre marque est basé sur la compétence et l'engagement de chaque individu.

Come specialista delle esportazioni, siete l'interfaccia centrale per i nostri flussi internazionali di merci e assicuratevi che le nostre spedizioni siano gestite senza intoppi, nel tempo e nel rispetto delle regole in tutto il mondo. Combinate le competenze di esportazione con il coordinamento, la consulenza e lo sviluppo continuo dei nostri processi.

Cosa farai

• Organizza e coordina spedizioni nazionali e internazionali di merci e documenti e garantisci il rispetto di tutte le normative doganali, di esportazione e di commercio estero

• È possibile creare, controllare e gestire documenti di esportazione, dogana e spedizione (ad esempio certificati di origine, carnet ATA, certificati di materiale) e garantire la loro corretta trasmissione.

• Monitorare i trasporti, coordinare la cooperazione con spedizionieri, autorità e dipartimenti interni e garantire una consegna tempestiva

• Supporti i processi di importazione, elabora le fatture di trasporto, mantieni i dati master e gli spedizionieri nel sistema ERP e coordina la pianificazione delle vacanze.

• L'utente sostiene l'organizzazione e la gestione delle spedizioni di merci pericolose e garantisce la corretta documentazione e l'etichettatura in conformità alle normative vigenti.

• Sei la persona di contatto per le parti interessate interne ed esterne su questioni di esportazione, doganale e commercio estero e fornire formazione sui processi di esportazione, nonché SAP GTS e SAP EWM.

• Partecipate attivamente all'ottimizzazione e all'ulteriore sviluppo dei nostri processi di esportazione, istruzioni di lavoro e soluzioni di sistema

Chi sei

• Hai completato una formazione commerciale e hai completato idealmente un'ulteriore formazione nel campo dell'esportazione, del commercio estero, della dogana o della logistica.

• Hai già diversi anni di esperienza nella lavorazione delle esportazioni internazionali e desideri approfondire ulteriormente il tuo know-how.

• Conoscete SAP; l'esperienza con SAP GTS e SAP EWM è un vantaggio.

• Lavori in sicurezza con spedizionieri, autorità doganali e contatti internazionali. La conoscenza dei beni pericolosi è un vantaggio.

• Si comunica con stile in tedesco e inglese – sia verbalmente che per iscritto.

• Si lavora in modo indipendente, strutturato e accuratamente e mantenere una panoramica anche in un ambiente dinamico.

• Sei una personalità impegnata e orientata al servizio che ama prendersi la responsabilità e apprezzare lo scambio nel team.

Chi siamo

A Belimo, siamo orgogliosi di rendere la nostra azienda un luogo gratificante per lavorare. I nostri leader sono orientati al valore e promuovono nuove idee nelle loro squadre in tutto il mondo. Attraverso la nostra passione, i nostri dipendenti non solo creano prodotti sorprendenti, ma anche rivoluzionano l'industria HVAC. Investire nei nostri dipendenti è al centro di Belimo quando si tratta di coinvolgere diversi talenti creativi per costruire una società leader del settore. Il successo del nostro marchio aziendale si basa sulla competenza e l'impegno di ogni individuo.

As an export specialist, you are the central interface for our international flows of goods and ensure that our shipments are handled smoothly, on time and in compliance with the rules worldwide. You combine export expertise with coordination, consulting and the continuous development of our processes.

What will you do

• You organize and coordinate national and international shipments of goods and documents and ensure compliance with all customs, export and foreign trade regulations

• You create, check and manage export, customs and shipping documents (e.g. certificates of origin, carnet ATA, material certificates) and ensure their correct transmission.

• You monitor transports, coordinate cooperation with forwarders, authorities and internal departments and ensure a timely delivery

• You support import processes, process freight invoices, maintain master data and forwarders in the ERP system and coordinate the holiday planning.

• You support the organisation and handling of dangerous goods shipments and ensure the correct documentation and labelling in accordance with the applicable regulations.

• You are the contact person for internal and external stakeholders on export, customs and foreign trade issues and provide training on export processes as well as SAP GTS and SAP EWM.

• You actively participate in the optimization and further development of our export processes, work instructions and system solutions

Who you are

• You have completed a commercial training and ideally completed a further education in the field of export, foreign trade, customs or logistics.

• You already have several years of experience in international export processing and would like to deepen your know-how further.

• You are familiar with SAP; Experience with SAP GTS and SAP EWM is an advantage.

• You work safely with forwarders, customs authorities and international contacts. Knowledge of dangerous goods is a plus.

• You communicate stylishly in German and English – both verbally and in writing.

• You work independently, structured and carefully and keep an overview even in a dynamic environment.

• You are a committed, service-oriented personality who likes to take responsibility and appreciate the exchange in the team.

Who we are

At Belimo, we are proud to make our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and promote new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees not only create amazing products, but also revolutionize the HVAC industry. Investing in our employees is at the heart of Belimo when it comes to engaging diverse creative talents to build an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the competence and commitment of each individual.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sintesi

In qualità di System Architect, formerai e guiderai architetture di sistemi scalabili che consentono una crescita del prodotto a lungo termine e un'integrazione cross-domain. Si agisce come un'autorità tecnica chiave, traducendo i requisiti di business e di sistema in soluzioni architettoniche robuste mentre guida team e stakeholder in tutta l'organizzazione.

Cosa farai

• Guidare e coordinare la progettazione di architetture di sistemi scalabili attraverso prodotti e progetti.

• Identificare le esigenze architettoniche, definire le opzioni di soluzione e guidare decisioni architettoniche informate.

• Agire come il principale contatto per le sfide architettoniche cross-domain (hardware, software, reti).

• Assicurare l'allineamento con principi architettonici, standard e obiettivi strategici.

• Traduci i requisiti in artefatti di architettura (driver, vincoli, attributi di qualità).

• Definire e governare le interfacce standardizzate per l'integrazione del sistema senza soluzione di continuità.

• Fornire leadership tecnica attraverso mentoring, workshop e guida architettonica.

• Documento, comunicazione e miglioramento continuo delle decisioni e metodologie architettoniche.

Chi sei

• Laurea in ingegneria (ad esempio ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria dei sistemi, meccatronica, robotica).

• Diversi anni di esperienza nell'architettura dei sistemi per dispositivi incorporati.

• Forte competenza nell'integrazione hardware e cross-domain.

• Esperienza con metodi architettonici, strumenti MBSE e pratiche di ingegneria dei sistemi.

• Capacità comprovata di condurre decisioni tecniche e allineare gli stakeholder interdisciplinari.

• Esperienza nella leadership tecnica, nella mentoring e nella collaborazione interfunzionale.

• Familiarità con la governance dell'architettura, gli standard e il miglioramento continuo.

• Eccellente abilità inglese, forte capacità di comunicazione e presentazione, e una mentalità olistica.

Chi siamo

A Belimo, siamo orgogliosi di rendere la nostra azienda un luogo gratificante per lavorare. I nostri leader sono orientati al valore e incoraggiano nuove idee nelle loro squadre in tutto il mondo. Attraverso la nostra passione, i nostri dipendenti non solo creano prodotti sorprendenti, stanno rivoluzionando l'industria HVAC. Investire nella nostra gente è al centro dell'approccio di Belimo a coinvolgere diversi talenti creativi per crescere un'azienda leader del settore. Il successo del nostro marchio aziendale si basa sulla competenza e l'impegno di ogni individuo.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Summary

As a Systems Architect, you will shape and lead scalable systems architectures that enable long-term product growth and cross-domain integration. You act as a key technical authority, translating business and system requirements into robust architectural solutions while guiding teams and stakeholders across the organization.

What You'll Do

• Lead and coordinate the design of scalable systems architectures across products and projects.

• Identify architectural needs, define solution options, and drive informed architectural decisions.

• Act as the main contact for cross-domain architectural challenges (hardware, software, networks).

• Ensure alignment with architectural principles, standards, and strategic objectives.

• Translate requirements into architecture artifacts (drivers, constraints, quality attributes).

• Define and govern standardized interfaces for seamless system integration.

• Provide technical leadership through mentoring, workshops, and architectural guidance.

• Document, communicate, and continuously improve architectural decisions and methodologies.

Who You Are

• Engineering degree (e.g. Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics).

• Several years of experience in systems architecture for embedded devices.

• Strong expertise in hardware and cross-domain integration.

• Experience with architectural methods, MBSE tools, and systems engineering practices.

• Proven ability to lead technical decisions and align interdisciplinary stakeholders.

• Experience in technical leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration.

• Familiarity with architecture governance, standards, and continuous improvement.

• Excellent English skills, strong communication and presentation abilities, and a holistic mindset.

Who We Are

At Belimo, we take pride in making our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and encourage new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees are not only creating amazing products, they are revolutionizing the HVAC industry. Investing in our people is at the heart of Belimo's approach to engaging diverse creative talent to grow an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the expertise and commitment of each individual.

 basic commercial or technical training; Further education or studies in marketing/communication are advantageous
